integrity: The degree is proved by an explicit projective-bundle intersection calculation and replayed by two exact integer-arithmetic reductions in the bundled verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the 3-by-3 compression component and does not compute the other component degrees or a general (a,b) formula. Targeted literature searches cannot exclude every unindexed general formula that specializes to the same degree.
title: The compression component of \(3\times 3\) matrix nets has Plücker degree \(927\)
